# curl
> The official home of curl and libcurl, the command-line tool and C library for transferring data with URLs.

curl.se hosts downloads, documentation, API references, tutorials, release information, security guidance, and community resources for the curl project maintained by Daniel Stenberg and contributors.

## Project Overview
- [curl Home](https://curl.se/): Project homepage with overview, supported protocols, latest release, and source code links.
- [About curl](https://curl.se/docs/): Documentation hub linking tutorials, manuals, FAQs, and protocol-specific guides.
- [Project Dashboard](https://curl.se/dashboard.html): Development metrics, release statistics, test status, and project activity overview.
- [Support curl](https://curl.se/support.html): Commercial support options and ways to fund or sponsor curl development.
- [The curl logo](https://curl.se/logo/): Official curl logos, branding assets, and usage information.

## Downloads and Releases
- [Download curl](https://curl.se/download.html): Source archives, release tarballs, signatures, hashes, and release notes.
- [curl for Windows](https://curl.se/windows/): Windows binaries, installers, build variants, and verification details.
- [Release Table](https://curl.se/download.html#releasetable): Historical release list with versions, dates, and package links.
- [Changes](https://curl.se/changes.html): Detailed changelog covering fixes, features, and protocol updates across releases.
- [Vulnerabilities](https://curl.se/docs/vulnerabilities.html): Security issue history with affected versions, severity, and fixes.

## curl Command Documentation
- [curl.1 man page](https://curl.se/docs/manpage.html): Complete command-line reference for curl options, protocols, and behaviors.
- [The curl Tutorial](https://curl.se/docs/tutorial.html): Introductory guide to common curl usage patterns and protocol examples.
- [HTTP scripting with curl](https://curl.se/docs/httpscripting.html): Practical guide to automating HTTP requests and web interactions with curl.
- [FAQ](https://curl.se/docs/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about usage, builds, protocols, and troubleshooting.
- [SSLCERTS](https://curl.se/docs/sslcerts.html): How curl verifies TLS certificates and uses CA stores on platforms.
- [CA Extract](https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html): Mozilla-derived CA certificate bundle in PEM format for curl and libcurl.

## Everything curl Book
- [Everything curl](https://curl.se/book.html): Free online book covering curl, libcurl, internals, protocols, and development.
- [Everything curl online](https://everything.curl.dev/): Structured web edition of the book with searchable chapters and examples.
- [Command line basics](https://everything.curl.dev/cmdline): Book section covering curl command-line concepts, syntax, and transfers.
- [libcurl](https://everything.curl.dev/libcurl): Book section introducing libcurl APIs, handles, callbacks, and usage patterns.
- [Internals](https://everything.curl.dev/internals): Book section on architecture, state machines, tests, and implementation details.

## libcurl API Reference
- [libcurl API Overview](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/): Entry point for the libcurl C API reference and interface documentation.
- [libcurl tutorial](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-tutorial.html): Programming tutorial introducing easy and multi interfaces with examples.
- [libcurl easy interface](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-easy.html): Overview of the easy interface for single transfers and common options.
- [libcurl multi interface](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-multi.html): Overview of concurrent, event-driven transfers using the multi interface.
- [libcurl share interface](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-share.html): Shared data interface for cookies, DNS cache, and connection reuse.
- [libcurl URL interface](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-url.html): URL parsing and manipulation API for structured URL handling.
- [libcurl WebSocket interface](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-ws.html): API overview for WebSocket support in libcurl.
- [libcurl symbols index](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/symbols-in-versions.html): Symbol availability by version for compatibility and upgrade planning.

## libcurl Examples and Bindings
- [libcurl examples](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/example.html): Collection of example C programs demonstrating common libcurl tasks.
- [libcurl bindings](https://curl.se/libcurl/bindings.html): Community-maintained language bindings for libcurl across many ecosystems.
- [libcurl internals](https://curl.se/libcurl/): libcurl documentation hub with API, examples, internals, and related resources.
- [ABI and API](https://curl.se/libcurl/abi.html): Compatibility guarantees and versioning policy for libcurl interfaces.

## Development and Source
- [Source code](https://curl.se/dev/source.html): Source repository access, git information, and development source details.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/curl/curl): Main curl source code repository with issues, pull requests, and releases.
- [Development docs](https://curl.se/dev/): Developer hub for contributing, testing, internals, and release engineering.
- [Release procedure](https://curl.se/dev/release-procedure.html): Step-by-step process used to prepare and publish curl releases.
- [Roadmap](https://curl.se/dev/roadmap.html): Planned work, priorities, and future development ideas for curl.
- [Test suite](https://curl.se/dev/testsuite.html): Overview of curl's automated test infrastructure and testing approach.

## Security
- [Security](https://curl.se/docs/security.html): Security policies, reporting guidance, and general security information for curl.
- [Security process](https://curl.se/docs/security.html#process): How curl handles vulnerability reports, embargoes, and coordinated disclosure.
- [Vulnerability disclosure policy](https://curl.se/docs/vuln-disclosure.html): Rules and expectations for reporting security issues responsibly.
- [Known vulnerabilities](https://curl.se/docs/vulnerabilities.html): Archive of published curl and libcurl security advisories.
- [CVE statistics](https://curl.se/docs/cve.html): Historical CVE data and security trends for the project.

## Community and Communication
- [Mailing lists](https://curl.se/mail/): Community mailing lists for users, developers, announcements, and archives.
- [Mailing list archives](https://curl.se/mail/archive-2025-03/): Public monthly archives of curl mailing list discussions.
- [IRC and chat](https://curl.se/community.html): Community channels and ways to interact with curl developers and users.
- [Contributing](https://curl.se/dev/contribute.html): How to contribute code, docs, tests, and bug reports to curl.
- [Bug bounty](https://curl.se/docs/bugbounty.html): Reward program details for qualifying security vulnerability reports.

## Protocols and Features
- [Protocols](https://curl.se/docs/protdocs.html): Protocol-specific documentation and references for supported transfer protocols.
- [HTTP](https://curl.se/docs/http-cookies.html): HTTP-related documentation including cookies and web transfer behavior.
- [FTP](https://curl.se/docs/ftpget.html): FTP usage examples and guidance for transfers with curl.
- [WebSocket](https://curl.se/docs/websocket.html): Documentation for curl and libcurl WebSocket support and usage.
- [Feature matrix](https://curl.se/docs/features.html): Overview of major curl and libcurl capabilities and optional features.
